serial.implementation: The serial agent spent the trajectory probing markdown and argparse behavior but did not create the planned /output artifacts before cancellation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation copied an empty output directory, so no entry point, library module, or harness was delivered.
serial.verification: Verification remained empirical reference probing only; there was no integrated Node implementation to run against the official evaluator before closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had the same prompt requiring pure Node.js ESM .mjs modules, zero external dependencies, exact CLI behavior, character-exact output, and /output delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had the same prompt and recognized the need to emulate Python-Markdown behavior, argparse, ESM modules, entry file, and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement difference in the prompt; the divergence was execution, where parallel split the requirements and serial pursued them locally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into three child-owned scopes: markdown engine, CLI/entry, and verification harness.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all scopes in one agent and listed probing, markdown modules, argparse, entry, and harness as pending local tasks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel assigned concrete child owners and completed two partial scopes; serial did no delegation and never advanced beyond local probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent's swarm prompt gave each child file ownership and an interface expectation, including markdown.mjs for the engine and test14.mjs importing it.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained a single context, accumulating executable probes and a local todo list for the same module set without cross-agent handoffs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel depended on a child result boundary for the engine; serial had no interface handoff but also no completed implementation to integrate.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced CLI parsing and the entry flow, and a separate harness, while the engine child spent its time probing and extracting behavior rather than writing markdown.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial repeatedly probed block, inline, HTML, list, and emphasis behavior, but never wrote the planned implementation files before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left a partial artifact set with runnable scaffolding missing the engine; serial left no artifact files at all.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent received an AgentSwarm aggregate with two completed children and one started but aborted markdown-engine child after the active turn was cancelled.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The single serial turn was cancelled while still in the main trajectory, with no child result lifecycle and no deliverable return.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child-result lifecycle failure for the required engine; serial had a plain single-agent cancellation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel's artifact copy contained argparse.mjs, verify.mjs, and test14.mjs, reflecting completed sibling writes but no markdown.mjs engine file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation copied an empty artifact directory and expected test14.mjs was missing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel integrated partial side-effected files but lacked the required library dependency; serial had no final tree to integrate.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had a completed harness child that explicitly reported the real harness was awaiting markdown.mjs; the official evaluator then scored 0/69.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed many executable probes but never ran an integrated final harness over a produced solution; the official evaluator also scored 0/69.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had partial verification infrastructure blocked by the missing engine, while serial verification remained exploratory only.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the run budget while waiting for the engine child; both the main swarm and engine child were cancelled before engine completion.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed the run budget during continued empirical probing and was cancelled before starting the planned implementation work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure pressure manifested at a child lifecycle boundary; serial closure pressure manifested as a single-agent over-investigation timeout.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both completed official evaluations failed 0/69. Parallel did more artifact-producing work, but its required markdown engine child was cancelled before return, leaving only CLI, harness, and entry scaffolding. Serial failed differently: it kept probing within one main trajectory, still had implementation tasks pending, and copied no artifact files. The retained parallel pattern is an adverse coordination episode inside a both-fail pair, not an explanation for a discordant outcome.
parallel_contributors: AgentSwarm split the solution and returned with the markdown-engine child started but aborted.
The final copied artifact lacked markdown.mjs despite containing CLI and harness files.
serial_contributors: The single serial agent spent the available time probing Python-Markdown behavior.
No /output artifacts were copied for serial at evaluation time.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's failure is ordinary over-investigation/no-delivery rather than a concurrency coordination pattern.
Parallel's completed CLI and harness scaffolding still could not run because the library dependency was missing.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a parallel adverse process consequence within a both-fail pair
